data.description:
SQLite persistence: open, migrate, seed from JSON, filtered search query, cities query, ping. Spec: docs/SPEC.md §4.1, §4.2, §5.2, §6.1, §8 (store list), §11.

Why: the handout wants real logic over the dataset; SQLite gives a real WHERE clause (filters) while ranking stays in Go (BC-3). Seeding must be idempotent because the container restarts on every hot reload.

Scope (package internal/store, plus seed loading):
- `Open(ctx, dsn string) (*Store, error)` using modernc.org/sqlite (pure Go). Pragmas: busy_timeout=5000, foreign_keys=on, journal_mode=WAL when not :memory:. Single connection for :memory: so the schema is shared.
- Embedded migrations under internal/store/migrations/ (0001_listings.sql per §4.1 including schema_migrations and the four indexes). `Migrate(ctx)` applies pending files in order inside a transaction; running it twice is a no-op.
- `seed.Load(path string) ([]domain.Listing, error)`: strict JSON decode (DisallowUnknownFields), per-record validation and normalization per §4.2; errors name the record index and field. `(*Store).Upsert(ctx, []domain.Listing) (int, error)` in one transaction with ON CONFLICT(source, id) DO UPDATE.
- `(*Store).Search(ctx, domain.SearchFilter) ([]domain.Listing, error)`: builds the WHERE clause per §6.1 with parameterized args only; keyword tokens use `instr(lower(description), ?) > 0`; status uses IN with one placeholder per value; ORDER BY source, id.
- `(*Store).Cities(ctx) ([]string, error)` distinct case-insensitively, sorted, first-seen casing.
- `(*Store).Ping(ctx) error`; wire into main.go so /healthz returns 503 {"status":"degraded"} when it fails. main.go opens the store, migrates, seeds from LISTINGS_FILE, and exits non-zero with a clear log on any failure.
- Tests per §8 store list against :memory: using the real data/sample_listings.json: 12 rows after seed, 12 after seeding twice, each filter alone and combined, keyword tokens containing % and _ are literal, multi-token AND, status sets, city case-insensitive and trimmed, Cities output exact.

Acceptance:
- `go run ./cmd/api` against a fresh DB_PATH logs "seeded 12 listings" and /healthz is ok.
- Every filter in §6.1 has a passing test; `make check` green for the backend.
- No string concatenation of user input into SQL anywhere (reviewer greps for it).

Validation: start the binary with DB_PATH=/tmp/x.db, confirm 12 rows (sqlite3 CLI or a one-off go run), curl /healthz, restart and confirm still 12; attach the output with --role validation.
data.title: SQLite store: schema migrations, JSON seed loader, filtered search query, cities query

data.body: From BC-2 (types frozen at review, branch feat/BC-2-backend-scaffold @ 5da9b80): domain.Listing.ListedDate is time.Time (a calendar date, midnight UTC); the JSON tags on Listing name the wire keys only. Never json.Marshal/Unmarshal Listing, or any struct embedding it (e.g. Scored), directly to or from the wire: time.Time encodes as RFC 3339 and rejects a bare YYYY-MM-DD. Parse and format the date with domain.DateLayout ("2006-01-02") in your own boundary record/DTO structs. Also: GET /healthz already has the 503 branch ({"status":"degraded","error":"database unavailable"}, real error logged only) and a failing-Pinger httpapi test; BC-4 only wires the store as Deps.Pinger in cmd/api run() (and may extend the test with the real store). The store must satisfy httpapi.Pinger: Ping(ctx context.Context) error.

Plan-review triage (art_01M4W2MFYZ0TVC255R5K8WKHP0, PASS): 6 obvious items folded into the plan's Resolutions block (BeginTx wording for migrations/upsert; I3 fixture bootstraps schema_migrations on a raw store; I2 asserts the four indexes by name; Open also rejects a file: prefix; rowid/VACUUM risk noted for Cities first-seen; T2 compares ListedDate with Equal). 1 evolutionary item skipped: adding (source, id) to seed RecordError, because the agreed message text is what validation checks and the index already locates the record. No complex items. Plan's SPEC §4.2 edit (non-empty id/source, unique (source,id) within a file) accepted: it enforces SPEC §4's identity rule; sample data passes.

BC-2 landed on master (b273a8a); merged master into feat/BC-4-sqlite-store at 318ebc5 per card note 1. REVIEW_BASE is now master. Gate make lint-api test-api green after merge (lint 0 issues; 36 top-level tests pass).

From BC-3 review (informational): domain.AgeDays/Recency take the UTC calendar date of Listing.ListedDate. The store must return ListedDate as midnight UTC, i.e. time.Parse(domain.DateLayout, s), never a local-midnight time.Time; a UTC+N local midnight would shift the age by one day.

Code review art_01M4W3X92E3R58R3C7QHCR8TXJ: PASS at 318ebc5. Routing: (1) migrate.go:46 bootstrap race between two processes on a new DB file — skipped for BC-4: v1 runs a single API process and a restart recovers; (2) listings.go:72 ListedDate.Format without UTC() — skipped for BC-4: seed.Load always yields UTC midnight, matching the domain invariant from BC-2 (calendar date, midnight UTC). Both captured in backlog ticket BC-18 so they are not lost and need no re-review cycle here. Three no-action notes acknowledged (:memory: single-connection Ping wait, SIGTERM during seed exits 1, errors.AsType needs Go 1.26+ which go.mod satisfies).

Exact-head review art_01M4W554XM9SHY2F8MP25KD1YD: PASS at 9daad85 (after merging BC-7 at 532996f and BC-3 at 9daad85; both merges clean, backend/internal/store, cmd and httpapi byte-identical to 318ebc5). Routing: migrate.go:46 bootstrap race — skipped, already tracked in BC-18; store_test.go re-seed does not assert Cities first-seen order — skipped here to avoid another re-review cycle, added to BC-18 (comment there explains why the sample data alone cannot catch it). Prior review art_01M4W4NDVFNAECWP264KDJVVYN PASS at 532996f; art_01M4W3X92E3R58R3C7QHCR8TXJ PASS at 318ebc5.

Completion (delegator): built backend/internal/store (Open with DSN pragmas busy_timeout/foreign_keys/WAL-for-files plus _txlock=immediate, single connection for :memory:; embedded migrations with schema_migrations, per-file BeginTx, idempotent; Upsert ON CONFLICT(source,id) DO UPDATE in one tx; Search with §6.1 WHERE from constant fragments and ? args only, instr(lower(description), ?) per token, status IN one placeholder per value, ORDER BY source,id; Cities distinct NOCASE, sorted, first-seen casing by min(rowid); Ping), backend/internal/store/seed (strict per-record decode with pointer DTO, DisallowUnknownFields, 0-based 'record index N: field "x"' errors, §4.2 normalization), modernc.org/sqlite v1.60.1 as the only direct dependency, main.go wiring (seed.Load before store.Open so a bad file never creates a DB; logs 'seeded N listings'; Deps.Pinger = store; store closed on shutdown), TestHealthzRealStore. Deviations: empty DB_PATH also rejected; reworded JSON type errors; RecordError path-prefix rules; SPEC §4.2 sentence in its own commit (20d0d51). Findings routed: plan-review 6 fixed, 1 skipped; code reviews 3 x PASS, nits in BC-18. Validation PASS at 318ebc5, 532996f and 9daad85 on port 18004. Handed off LAND-READY at 9daad85.
